metadata.description: Controlled Language: an agent skill that writes, rewrites, and reviews clear, readable, unambiguous text in any language (documentation, instructions, emails, reports, answers), based on the principles of ASD-STE100, at three strictness levels.

plugins.name: controlled-language
plugins.description: Write, rewrite, and review clear, readable, unambiguous text in any language (ASD-STE100 principles). English: full rules; other languages: the same principles with language files. Levels 1 Light, 2 Standard, 3 Strict.
